The issuer operates with massive scale but severely impaired profitability, generating a negligible EBIT margin ($7M on $9.29B revenue) and a net loss of $139M, alongside a leveraged capital structure (total liabilities of $7.48B against $2.52B in equity) and a tight current ratio of 1.21x. While substantial total assets ($10.04B) and positive retained earnings indicate historical size and equity buffer, the immediate inability to cover interest and operational costs from profits severely increases credit risk. These financial weaknesses position the company well into high-yield speculative territory, though not in immediate default or extreme distress.

DECISION: B
